total_charge.description: UNUSED SIGNAL. See legacy AMS firmware (code-2024) for usage.

total_discharge.description: UNUSED SIGNAL. See legacy AMS firmware (code-2024) for usage.

overvoltage_error.description: Whether or not the energy meter is reading an over-voltage error.

max_charging_voltage_high.description: Unused for any PCAN stuff only for Elcon Charger

max_charging_voltage_low.description: Unused for any PCAN stuff only for Elcon Charger

max_charging_current_high.description: Unused for any PCAN stuff only for Elcon Charger

max_charging_current_low.description: Unused for any PCAN stuff only for Elcon Charger

em_current.description: The current draw, in amps, measured by the Energy Meter.

em_voltage.description: The voltage, in Volts, measured by the Energy Meter.

voltage_gain.description: This selects the "gain" mode for the EM voltage measurements. The specific multipliers for each gain mode are configured with the EMD Tool.

current_gain.description: This selects the "gain" mode for the EM current measurements. The specific multipliers for each gain mode are configured with the EMD Tool.

overpower_error.description: Whether or not the Energy Meter is reading an over-power error.

logging.description: Whether or not the energy meter is currently logging data.

drive_mode.description: The current drive mode on the ECU irrespective of dial mapping

tcu_recording_state.description: The current state of TCU data recording (off, requested,on,saving)

glv_led.description: glv led has a value from 0 to 255 representing a percentage that can be displayed on dashboard as a gradient between two colors

pack_charge_led.description: pack charge led has a value from 0 to 255 representing a percentage that can be displayed on dashboard as a gradient between two colors

driver_message.description: corresponds to a pre-set list of driver messages on the dashboard that the TCU can request to be displayed in event of comms failure

target_lap_time.description: target lap time is the time determined by the pit crew that the driver should aim for. mostly useful for guiding the driver in endurance races.

current_shunt_read.description: The shunt in penthouse; Measures current that goes through the whole tractive system -- used for coulumb counting

SoC.description: The charge in the accumulator, as a percentage.

min_cell_voltage_est.description: Lowest-cell-voltage estimate based on the state of charge, according to VOLTAGE_LOOKUP_TABLE. Ex: 87% SoC would display 3.798V.

charge_coulombs.description: The charge in the accumulator, in Coulombs

vn_vel_uncertainty.description: how much error there might be

torque_request.description: The torque request calculated from the accelleration request and the maximum torque

accel_request_state.description: The current state of the acceleration request (0 = decelerating, 1 = accelerating)

launch_control_state.description: The current state of the launch controller (LAUNCH_NOT_READY, LAUNCH_READY, LAUNCHING)

algo_active.description: State of whether the launch algorithm has taken over control from the initial launch target

initial_launch_target.description: The initial launch speed target requested by the launch controller

steering_analog_raw.description: raw measurement as measured by bottom steering analog sensor

steering_digital_raw.description: raw measurement by digital steering encoder

speed_above_thresh.description: Vehicle speed is above 5 m/s, TCMux does not allow driver to switch mode

torque_delta_above_thresh.description: Torque delta between old and new controllers is < 0.5Nm on every wheel

tc_not_ready.description: Selected TC not in ready state

torque_limit.description: AMK inverter torque limit in use

num_sats_pvt_1.description: num of common satelites that are used in the PVT solution on receiver A

num_sats_rtk_1.description: num of common satelites that are used in the RTK solution on receiver A

highest_cn0_1.description: Highest CN0 reported on receiver A

num_sats_pvt_2.description: num of common satelites that are used in the PVT solution on receiver B

num_sats_rtk_2.description: num of common satelites that are used in the RTK solution on receiver B

highest_cn0_2.description: Highest CN0 reported on receiver B

num_com_sats_pvt.description: num of common satelites that are used in the PVT solution on both receivers

num_com_sats_rtk.description: num of common satelites that are used in the RTK solution on both receivers

implaus_exceeded_max_duration.description: a pedal implausibility has been present for longer than allowed

brake_pedal.description: the scaled brake pedal value between 0 and 1

Height_Offset.description: This value will be SUBTRACTED from the height.  So if you mount the sensor at 40cm, and you want that to read as 20cm, set this value to 20cm

Sensor_X_Location.description: This is the X position of the center of the sensor, with ISO signedness (positive is forward, negative is rearward) This is used to generate the CG_Corrected velocities

Sensor_Y_Location.description: This is the Y position of the center of the sensor, with ISO signedness (positive is left (driver side in US) negative is right (passenger) This is used to generate the CG_Corrected velocities

Temperature_Internal.description: Measurement of the internal air temperature of the SpeedBeam sensor

Height.description: Height after adjusting for height offset

Velocity_x.description: ISO Standard Sign, Positive is Vehicle Moving Forward

Velocity_y.description: ISO Standard Sign, Positive is Vehicle Turning Left

Velocity_z.description: ISO Standard Sign, Positive is Vehicle Moving Up

Velocity_x_CGCorrected.description: ISO Standard Sign, Positive is Vehicle Moving Forward

Velocity_y_CGCorrected.description: ISO Standard Sign, Positive is Vehicle Turning Left

Velocity_z_CGCorrected.description: ISO Standard Sign, Positive is Vehicle Moving Up

brake_temp_channel_1.description: brake rotor temp sensor channel reading in degrees C

brake_rotor_sensor_temp.description: temperature internal to the sensor degrees C

brake_temp_sensor_can_bitrate.description: bitrate setting for CAN on the brake temp sensor. 1 = 1M, 2 = 500k, 3 = 250k, 4 = 100k

brake_temp_sensor_prog_const.description: programming constant, should be set to 30000

inverter_overload_percentage.description: the current overload of the inverter according to the i2t calc

motor_overload_percentage.description: the current overload of the motor according to the i2t calc

in_steering_calibration_state.description: Input from VCR to tell VCF if steering can calibrate or not
